answer: We formulate a decentralized mechanism incorporating dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices, where agents' strategic interactions are mediated by a saffron-hued threat of punishment, causing would-be Sybil attackers to wander into a trap of negative expected payoffs, as the subgame-perfect equilibrium entails a strict Nash equilibrium wherein honest participation dominates, rendering Sybilization unprofitable, and prompting agents to whisper only truthful reports, thus guaranteeing robustness against identity multiplication.
